opportunities.name: AD-ratio voidling hybrid
opportunities.objective: Explore Void Swarm's AD expression while preserving magic penetration.
opportunities.mechanic: Voidlings deal magic per hit with 0.4 AD statFormula=2 and 0.2 AP, unlike physical owner attacks. Gunblade/Muramana supply mixed stats and mana; Rylai may keep enemies in pet range while Riftmaker supports sustained magic combat. E or Q sets up two stored W stacks for three Voidlings, then R can hold one target while pets attack.
opportunities.requiredState: Need charged Tear, two pre-W spell stacks and living Voidlings during the channel.
opportunities.failure: Area damage instantly kills pets; sacrificing AP weakens E/R and the first tick cannot rebuild them.
opportunities.test: Compare surviving pet hits and damage with AD versus AP increments, logging owner spell procs separately.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: AD-scaled pet magic damage does not justify lethality or automatic Muramana/Nashor inheritance.

opportunities.name: Vision-spread resistance denial
opportunities.objective: Use refreshed visions to carry repeated spell pressure between deaths.
opportunities.mechanic: Malefic Visions lasts four seconds and Q or R refreshes it; a victim death spreads it and restores a resource-based mana amount. Blackfire and Liandry add magic burn, Bloodletter rewards qualifying magic ticks and Rylai limits walking away. Cryptbloom provides a separate earned takedown heal, rather than assuming every minion spread makes a champion chain.
opportunities.requiredState: Need mana, refresh hits before expiry and an enemy close enough to receive the spread.
opportunities.failure: Vision transfer may pick a minion; interrupting R or clearing Voidlings cuts total pressure.
opportunities.test: Measure refresh duration, shred stacks and mana returned for minion versus champion deaths.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: E executes low-health minions; it does not give an equivalent automatic champion execute.

ruledOut.reason: The pet damage expression has AP/AD magic terms and no crit coefficient.

unknowns: Voidling item eligibility and R percent-health expression have ambiguous extraction; do not treat its symbolic 0.05 multiplier as a verified total.

builds.name: AD-ratio voidling hybrid
builds.summary: Explore Void Swarm's AD expression while preserving magic penetration.
builds.goal: Explore Void Swarm's AD expression while preserving magic penetration.
builds.hypothesis: Voidlings deal magic per hit with 0.4 AD statFormula=2 and 0.2 AP, unlike physical owner attacks. Gunblade/Muramana supply mixed stats and mana; Rylai may keep enemies in pet range while Riftmaker supports sustained magic combat. E or Q sets up two stored W stacks for three Voidlings, then R can hold one target while pets attack.
testPlan: Required state: Need charged Tear, two pre-W spell stacks and living Voidlings during the channel.
Compare surviving pet hits and damage with AD versus AP increments, logging owner spell procs separately.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Area damage instantly kills pets; sacrificing AP weakens E/R and the first tick cannot rebuild them.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: AD-scaled pet magic damage does not justify lethality or automatic Muramana/Nashor inheritance.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Hextech Gunblade, Muramana, Riftmaker, Rylai's Crystal Scepter, Rabadon's Deathcap, Sorcerer's Shoes. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

kitEvidence.formula:
Passive: Malzahar's other Abilities give him a stack when cast (max [2]).

Active: Malzahar summons a Voidling plus an additional Voidling per stack. Voidlings last [8 / 8 / 9 / 9 / 10] seconds and deal [12 / 14 / 16 / 18 / 20 + characterLevelInterpolation(5 → 64.5; raw flags preserved) + (0.4) × AD[statFormula=2] + (0.2) × AP] magic damage each hit.
Malzahar opens two portals to the Void that fire projectiles inward, dealing [70 / 105 / 140 / 175 / 210 + (0.55) × AP] magic damage and Silencing for [1 / 1.25 / 1.5 / 1.75 / 2] second(s).

Malzahar Suppresses an enemy champion and deals [125 / 200 / 275 + (0.8) × AP] magic damage over [2.5] seconds. A zone of negative energy is created around his target dealing [(2 / 3 / 4 + (0.005) × AP) × (0.05)] max Health magic damage over [5] seconds.

Malzahar inflicts terrible visions, dealing [80 / 115 / 150 / 185 / 220 + (0.8) × AP] magic damage over [4] seconds. Applying Call of the Void or Nether Grasp to the victim during this time refreshes the visions.

If the victim dies, Malzahar gains [0.02 × AbilityResource(default, statFormula=default)] Mana and the visions spread to the nearest enemy.

Malefic Visions executes minions below [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=10, perLevel=2, changes=[{"mLevel": 12, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])] Health.
